item.title: Great Valley’s comeback thwarts Rustin
item.description: WESTTOWN — The West Chester Rustin girls basketball team was ready to celebrate winning a Ches-Mont League American Division title and move one game from completing an undefeated league slate. But, Great Valley said, in the words of former ESPN college football analyst Lee Corso, “not so fast my friend.” The Patriots rallied from a halftime deficit and held the Golden Knights to one basket in the fourth quarter to post a 44-36 victory.
